exposure: Presence or absence of an isthmocele
cohort: 390 women with a history of childbirth and a transfer of one or more frozen embryos at blastocyst stage
finding: There was no significant difference in live birth rates following frozen blastocyst transfer between women with a previous Caesarean delivery and those with a previous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Embryo transfers were more often described as difficult in the Caesarean delivery group.
